name: Tuesday
bio: Archetype: Poison Core, Moxie Storage. ⌽ Allows all [Poison] to crit. ⌽ Allows all allies to store up to 5 excess Moxie. ⌽ Skills inflict multiple [Poison] stacks on several enemies, and lower their Crit Resistence. ⌽ Ult deals [Poison]-based Genesis damage and casts the Array [Horror Story Night]. ⌽ While her Array is active, prevents [Poison] stacks from decreasing and procs [Poison] one extra time at the start of the enemy's turn. On expiry, immediately procs all [Poison] on all enemies.
